clips.title: The story
paras: The Gem of Cobrahn is a dream gem carried by Lord Cobrahn, one of the corrupt leaders of the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns. It serves as both a focus of his corrupted reverie and physical proof needed by Nara Wildmane to confirm his defeat.

When the night elf druid Naralex entered the Emerald Dream to restore the barren plains of Kalimdor, his nightmare twisted both the Wailing Caverns and his disciples. Among them was Cobrahn, who abandoned the peaceful ways of the Cenarion Circle to take the shape of the serpent. Lord Cobrahn carries one of the four dream gems that anchor the leaders' hold over the subterranean waterways, using it to channel the twisted dreams that threaten to transform the Barrens into a venomous marsh.
